english.title: Registered person fail to provide summary of complaints and responses to Care Quality Commission
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[service provider]_
(B)_[registered manager]_

in respect of a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), failed to provide to the Commission, when requested to do so and by no later than 28 days beginning on the day after receipt of the request, a summary of complaints made under a complaints system established in accordance with regulation 16(2) of the Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014, responses made by you to such complaints and any further correspondence with the complainants in relation to such complaints and all other relevant information in relation to such complaints requested by the Commission, in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(3), 22(1)(b) and 23(5) of the Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 8(1) and (2) provides that a registered person must comply with regulations 9 to 20A in carrying on a regulated activity, unless the thing to be done has by another registered person in relation to the regulated activity concerned.
(ii) As per regulation 22(4), it is a defence for a registered person to prove that they took all reasonable steps and exercised all due diligence to prevent the breach.
